notes: No official Skoda EU/IL owner's-manual or service-schedule text could be read (ManualsLib Cloudflare-blocked, Skoda online manual host down, workshop Maintenance manual login-gated). Official-origin figures reach us only via (a) Skoda Egypt importer tables (EG market, 10,000 km/6 months oil - a severe/market-specific regime) and (b) BRISKODA forum relays of Skoda ERWIN/Skoda UK CS (UK, 2014, early Octavia III 1.4 TSI). Israeli practice evidence: Walla (Champion Motors, 2014) and carz.co.il both say 15,000 km or 1 year (fixed regime), with a larger service at 60,000 km per Walla. Regime: VW-group fixed (QI1-QI4, 15,000 km/1 yr) vs LongLife QI6 (up to 30,000 km/2 yr); IL appears to use fixed. Engine code for IL 2018 1.4 TSI not confirmed by any source read (CZDA 110 kW is the MY2017+ 150 hp EA211; Egypt lists CZDA as 140 hp in Kodiaq/Superb). Timing belt: manufacturer position (per ERWIN relay) is inspection-only (first after 150k miles, then every 18k miles); all replacement numbers are importer/independent. DQ200 dry-clutch DSG: no gearbox oil change per two sources. Coolant: EG importer 50,000 km; ERWIN relay says check only.
